propositions: MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY and /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key have a producer (SSM slot) and transport layer (user_data.sh, fetch-secrets.sh) but zero runtime consumers in the application codebase

the documented purpose of verdict signing for this secret was superseded by asymmetric Ed25519 operation certificates defined in ADR 0049, and the current shipped verdict-signing path uses the op-cert key, not any HMAC secret
retention of this secret creates a false audit signal and operator rotation toil with zero security effect, since nothing consumes the rotated value
removal must be atomic across the terraform slot producer and both transport mechanisms (user_data.sh and fetch-secrets.sh) to avoid boot-time fetch failures

safe removal requires removal of script references first, retention of the terraform slot for one release cycle as a rollback preserve, and then destruction of the slot after confirmation of no regression
